title: P1: Narrowed shelf stack pills hide a waiting agent’s dash
detail:
Narrowed shelf stack pills hide a waiting agent’s dash

A supported four-tile stack with three waiting members below the shown tile can render a 32-point pill. Its third 10-point dash starts at x=32 and disappears. The reviewer also reproduced this at the measured full width of a stack named 1 through 4. Budget space or use a compact representation that still shows each waiting member. Evidence is on s-2bt4aa.
